description: Report a bug, a missing feature or anything else about this service, in a structured way. Free. A person reads every report; nothing is run or changed automatically.

contact.description: Optional: how to reach you about it

endpoint.description: Optional: the route or tool it is about, e.g. /v1/token

message.description: What happened or what you need

payment.description: Optional: the payment it is about, when a paid call went wrong: its transaction (with the network) or a receipt id

network.description: Its network, e.g. eip155:8453 (Base), solana, xrpl:0

receipt.description: A receipt id you were given for it

tx.description: The transaction hash or signature, e.g. the settlement transaction from the pay answer

name: feedback

id.description: Report id, to refer to it later

received.description: true: a person will read it

title: Send feedback (free)
